title: LFV in flavourful SMEFT: Dimension-Six Running versus Dimension-Eight Mixing
summary: We study how charged-lepton flavour violation (CLFV) generated in the $τ$ sector propagates into the $μ\to e$ sector within the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT). Assuming that new physics at a scale $Λ\gg v$ produces only dimension-6 operators that mediate $τ\to e$ and $τ\toμ$ transitions, we identify and compare the three mechanisms that induce $μ\to e$ observables. All three originate from double insertions of the two $τ\to\ell$ operators and scale as $C_6^{τe}C_6^{τμ}/Λ^4$.
